title: Uniform Remix 솔로 #189 · 교복 · 스카프 탑 × 타탄 킬트 랩(금 핀·슬릿) · 플랫 페니 로퍼+네이비 니삭스 · curved bust · 정면 팔 내림 · 배경 레드카펫 계단 · 인스타글램
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, late 30s goddess, curved bust physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person; both her bust and her hips are simultaneously, dramatically enormous, a colossal heavy bust resting full and wide, and enormous round hips flaring just as dramatically wide below, but unlike a sharply cinched hourglass, her waistline stays soft and only gently defined between them, a full, natural figure rather than a snatched one; gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a full round face; her head looks small on top of her massive body; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, half-up half-down natural black hair — wearing a skin-tight micro school uniform set, a scarf top made from a navy-bordered white triangular school scarf of ultra-thin matte crisp white modal jersey folded around her bust, tied behind her neck and back, with its front corners knotted at the center of her chest under a small gold school pin and the two short ends hanging down, her shoulders, arms and midriff bare, and a micro tartan kilt wrap skirt of red tartan plaid modal jersey wrapped across the front and fastened at her hip with a large gold kilt pin, sitting at the top of her hip bones with the hem ending just below her hip bones, the wrap opening in a high slit up to her hip bone. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, faint freckles on her chest V and the backs of her hands and a small beauty mark near her lips. The garments cling like a second skin and show real material behaviour: the thin modal jersey molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, her hip bones and the gentle rise of her bust and hips, the soft matte drape of the white modal jersey against her bare shoulders and the clean edges of the tartan kilt and its gold pin, fine stretch lines and a soft powdery matte finish. Pose: standing tall facing the camera straight on, arms relaxed at her sides, weight even on both feet, her legs fully in view — most extreme curved bust silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: glossy black leather penny loafers with a small gold coin detail, worn with navy knee-high socks with a thin white stripe at the top, her feet planted flat on the floor.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, almond nails each longer than her middle finger, in forest green lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of large chandelier earrings of tin and blackened iron as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Black woman with strong, striking features, a broad nose and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: heavily sculpted contour and a strong highlighter on the cheekbones, bold defined brows, long fluffy false lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, plump glossy nude lips with a defined lip-liner outline.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows light natural skin glow, subtle healthy sheen.

Background: a wide red-carpeted grand staircase with standard-height steps, a waist-high brass handrail and warm daylight from tall windows, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so her full height reads at a glance, her shoes planted flat on the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
